title: Stop Saying "Very Hard" (Part 2)! 3 More English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very hard". Use one of these words instead:
• Challenging: Leo starts a new job at a busy cafe. It's a challenging job.
• Rough: Then the coffee machine breaks. It's a rough morning.
• Draining: But he serves every customer! What a draining day!

Part 1 (Tough, Tricky, Brutal): https://youtube.com/shorts/BquM8WfPvfY

Comment your own word for "very hard"!
